<title level="1" right="Summoner Eidolon " pfs="Standard">[Aberrant](/Eidolons.aspx?ID=14)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Aberration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=523" />
<trait label="Eidolon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=958" />
</traits>

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 70

Your eidolon is a terrifying, incomprehensible nightmare patterned after the creatures who owe their existence to the Outer Gods and Great Old Ones. Aberrant eidolons come in a variety of forms, though their anatomies often appear twisted and impossible. Most people can't even look at any aberrant eidolon without developing a splitting headache or having a panic attack, but your studies of the occult have inured your mind to these dread terrors.

<column gap="tiny">

**Tradition** [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Home Plane** Dimension of Dreams or [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Size** Medium or Small

**Suggested Attacks** claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), tentacle (bludgeoning)

- Str 
- Dex 
- Con 2
- Int 1
- Wis 1
- Cha -1
-  AC ( Dex cap)

**Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36), [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)

**Senses** [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Language** [Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=164)

**Speed** 25 feet

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Eidolon Abilities**

- **Initial** Surprising Anatomy <actions string="Reaction" />
- **Symbiosis** Unfathomable Mind
- **Transcendence** Maddening Whispers

</column>

<title level="2">Surprising Anatomy <actions string="Reaction" /></title>

**Trigger** An enemy adjacent to your eidolon deals damage to your eidolon; **Effect** Your eidolon's form shifts horribly to retaliate against the attacker. Your eidolon makes a melee unarmed Strike against the triggering enemy.

<title level="2" right="7th">Unfathomable Mind</title>

Those who try to touch your eidolon's mind find their own minds shattered. When your eidolon succeeds at a saving throw against a mental effect from a creature, that creature takes 4d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your spell DC. A creature who fails this save is also [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 (stupefied 2 on a critical failure). At 9th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

<title level="2" right="17th">Maddening Whispers</title>

Your aberrant eidolon utters terrible secrets about the true nature of the universe. They can cast [_unfathomable song_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1731) once per day as an innate occult spell. Your eidolon can Sustain this spell as a free action if they spend at least one action Striding toward one of the targets.

<title level="1" right="Summoner Eidolon " pfs="Standard">[Angel](/Eidolons.aspx?ID=1)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Angel" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=8" />
<trait label="Celestial" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=23" />
<trait label="Eidolon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=386" />
</traits>

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 59

Your eidolon is a celestial messenger, a member of the angelic host with a unique link to you, allowing them to carry a special message to the mortal world at your side. Most angel eidolons are roughly humanoid in form, with feathered wings, glowing eyes, halos, or similar angelic features. However, some take the form of smaller angelic servitors like the winged helmet [cassisian angel](/Monsters.aspx?ID=13) instead. The two of you are destined for an important role in the plans of the celestial realms. Though a true angel, your angel eidolon's link to you as a mortal prevents them from casting the [angelic messenger](/Rituals.aspx?ID=22) ritual, even if they somehow learn it.

<column gap="tiny">

**Tradition** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2)

**Alignment** must be good, usually neutral good

**Home Plane** [Nirvana](/Planes.aspx?ID=20) (if NG), [Elysium](/Planes.aspx?ID=16) (if CG), or [Heaven](/Planes.aspx?ID=17) (if LG)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Size** Medium or Small

**Suggested Attacks** fist (bludgeoning), wing (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

**Angelic Avenger**
- Str 18
- Dex 14
- Con 16
- Int 8
- Wis 12
- Cha 10
- +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

**Angelic Emissary**
- Str 12
- Dex 18
- Con 12
- Int 10
- Wis 12
- Cha 14
- +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

**Skills** [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6), [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13)

**Senses** [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415)

**Language** [Celestial](/Languages.aspx?ID=16)

**Speed** 25 feet

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Eidolon Abilities**

- **Initial** Hallowed Strikes
- **Symbiosis** Traveler's Aura
- **Transcendence** Angelic Mercy

</column>

<title level="2">Hallowed Strikes</title>

Your eidolon's attacks are hallowed by the celestial realms. Your eidolon's [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) Strikes gain the holy trait and deal 1 extra spirit damage to unholy creatures and creatures with weakness to holy. Additionally, your eidolon can make [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) attacks with its unarmed attacks without taking the usual –2 circumstance penalty.

<title level="2" right="7th">Traveler's Aura</title>

Your eidolon emanates a powerful aura—resembling that of an [astral deva](/Monsters.aspx?ID=16)—that protects creatures as they travel. The aura has the [abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), and [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48) traits. Your eidolon and its allies within a 20-foot emanation are protected from [severe heat and cold](/Rules.aspx?ID=642), and your eidolon is never [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) to creatures inside the aura that are of a lower level than the eidolon.

 When you gain the transcendence class feature, this evolves to the full benefits of an astral deva; your eidolon and allies in the aura are protected from environmental damage from any plane, including severe and extreme heat and cold as well as more unusual dangers.

<title level="2" right="17th">Angelic Mercy</title>

Your eidolon's angelic power allows them to assuage a variety of ailments, just like most other powerful angels. Your eidolon can cast [_remove curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=250), [_remove disease_](/Spells.aspx?ID=251), [_remove fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=252), and [_remove paralysis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=253) once per day each as 9th-level divine innate spells.

<trait label="Phantom" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=766" />

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 71

Your eidolon is a lost soul, bound to the mortal world by undying anger or a bitter grudge. Most phantom eidolons are humanoids with a spectral or ectoplasmic appearance, though some take far stranger forms. Your link with your eidolon prevents them from succumbing to corruption and undeath. Together, you will need to decide whether to work with your eidolon to control their anger or channel their wrath into power.

<column gap="tiny">

**Tradition** [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Home Plane** [Ethereal Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=34)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Size** Medium or Small

**Suggested Attacks** fist (bludgeoning), tendril (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

- Str 
- Dex 
- Con 3
- Int 0
- Wis -1
- Cha 1
-  AC ( Dex cap)

**Skills** [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40), [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)

**Senses** [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Language** one common mortal language the eidolon spoke in life

**Speed** 25 feet

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Eidolon Abilities**

- **Initial** Furious Strike <actions string="Two Actions" />
- **Symbiosis** Seething Frenzy <actions string="Single Action" />
- **Transcendence** Anger Aura

</column>

<title level="2">Furious Strike <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

Your eidolon makes a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, your eidolon deals an extra die of weapon damage and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the damage roll.

If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice with a +2 circumstance bonus, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice with a +3 circumstance bonus.

<title level="2" right="7th">Seething Frenzy <actions string="Single Action" /></title>

Your eidolon's fury boils over into a reckless, out-of-control frenzy. While frenzied, your eidolon is affected by [_boost eidolon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2913) and gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level, but takes a –1 penalty to AC. Your eidolon can't voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy. The frenzy and the accompanying temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute or until your eidolon is no longer manifested, whichever comes first, after which they can't start another frenzy for 1 minute.

 When your eidolon makes a Furious Strike while in a Seething Frenzy, the status bonus from _boost eidolon_ is 3 per damage die. The extra damage die from Furious Strike still doesn't count toward _boost eidolon's_ bonus, as normal for weapon dice added by abilities.

<title level="2" right="17th">Anger Aura</title>

Your eidolon exudes wrath in an aura, rousing the ire of nearby creatures and causing their defenses to crack as they seethe with rage. Your eidolon gains an anger aura in a 20-foot emanation. The resistances of any creature in the aura, including you, your allies, your enemies, and your eidolon, are reduced by 10. Your eidolon can hold in their rage by spending a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait. This reduces the aura's effect to affect only your eidolon. They can take this action again to reinstate the full effect of their aura. Creatures in a barbarian Rage, Seething Frenzy, or similar ability that allows them to channel their anger (such as Blood Frenzy) aren't affected by the anger aura.

You might have learned the way to connect with the world's life force via a specific philosophy or practice, such as the beliefs of the god callers of Sarkoris, or formed a bond on your own. Your eidolon rushes forward, using their momentum to increase the power of their attack. Your eidolon Strides twice and then Strikes. If the eidolon moved at least 20 feet away from their starting position and moved entirely in a straight line, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this attack roll.

Your eidolon unleashes a primal roar or other terrifying noise that fits your eidolon's form. Your eidolon attempts to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) each enemy that can hear the roar, comparing the result of a single Intimidation check to the Will DC of each target; this check doesn't take any penalty for not sharing a language.

Your eidolon lashes out in all directions. They make a melee unarmed Strike against up to four enemies within reach. They can choose different unarmed attacks for each enemy. Your eidolon is a mental construct based on an astral thoughtform and given physical presence and life by their connection to you, their shape limited only by your imagination. Your eidolon's appearance and physical form vary based on your shared vision for their construction, from clockworks to stuffed dolls and everything between, and it's not uncommon for that appearance to change greatly as your construct gains evolutions. Because they arise from an astral entity, your construct is no mindless servitor, but a fully thinking being with their own ideas, goals, and even emotions. These entities are extremely diverse; while many construct eidolons come from a powerful symbiotic connection with astral denizens, just as many arise from the forgotten memories of ancient empires and craftworks drifting across the Silver Sea of the Astral Plane.

<title level="2">Construct Heart</title>

Your construct eidolon has a link directly to your life force, which renders them a living creature and therefore susceptible to many ailments that bother only the living, though they do possess some resistances to these effects. They don't have a construct's normal immunities, but they do gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), and [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) effects, as well as effects causing the [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=73) or [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) conditions. Additionally, their astral essence bleeds off slowly. The flat check to remove [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) from the eidolon is DC 10 (or DC 5 after receiving particularly effective aid).

<title level="2" right="7th">Reconfigured Evolution</title>

Your construct eidolon is particularly easy to reconfigure, gaining an additional evolution that suits both of your whims. Choose one additional evolution feat of 6th level or lower. Your eidolon gains that feat. You can Retrain this feat for any other evolution feat of 6th level or lower with only a single day of downtime if you succeed at a Crafting check with a standard DC of your eidolon's level. If you fail, you can try again on a later day. Many summoners choose [Eidolon's Wrath](/Feats.aspx?ID=9246) for this ability.

<title level="2" right="17th">Ultimate Reconfiguration</title>

Your construct eidolon becomes even more customizable. Choose an evolution feat of 16th level or lower. Your eidolon gains that feat. You can spend downtime to adjust it using Crafting, just like the feat from reconfigured evolution. Many summoners select [Ever-Vigilant Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=9277) for this ability.

Most phantom eidolons are humanoid with a spectral or ectoplasmic appearance, though some take far stranger forms. **Trigger** An enemy within 15 feet of you hits you with a Strike and deals damage to you; **Requirements** Your eidolon is within 15 feet of you; **Effect** Your eidolon instinctively flashes with ectoplasmic energy, allowing them to strike back against an enemy who dares to harm you. <title level="2" right="7th">Steadfast Devotion</title>

Your eidolon's dedication makes it extremely challenging for your foes to bend their mind. Your eidolon gains a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects, and if they roll a success against such an effect, they get a critical success instead. If you have the shared resolve class feature and your eidolon rolls a critical failure against a mental effect, they get a failure instead.

After fighting at your side for so long, your eidolon has become as devoted to protecting you and your allies as they are to their original cause. Your eidolon gains a 20-foot devotion aura. Whenever one of your eidolon's allies (including you) within the aura takes damage, you can reduce the damage by 6. You lose a number of Hit Points equal to half the amount by which the eidolon reduced the damage, rounded down. If the damage was lower than 6, base the damage you take on the actual amount of damage prevented. For instance, if the eidolon prevented 5 damage, you would lose 2 HP.

Because dragons have a strong connection to magic, their minds can often leave an echo floating in the Astral Plane. Such an entity is extremely powerful but unable to interact with the outside world on their own. Dragon eidolons manifest in the powerful, scaled forms they had in life; most take the form of great dragons (albeit smaller), but some manifest as drakes or other draconic beings. You have forged a connection with such a dragon eidolon and together, you seek to grow as powerful as an archdragon.

</column>

<title level="2">Dragon Breath <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

Your eidolon exhales a blast of destructive energy that deals 1d6 damage to all creatures in an area with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. Your eidolon then can't use Dragon Breath again for the next 1d4 rounds. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

 When the eidolon gains this ability, you choose the area—a 60-foot line or a 30-foot cone—as well as the damage type—acid, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, poison, or void. You can instead choose force if your eidolon has the [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534) trait, spirit if they have the [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579) trait, or mental if they have the [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=662) trait. If you model your eidolon after a specific type of dragon, your GM might allow you to choose from additional damage types.

 Dragon Breath has the tradition trait of your eidolon and the trait matching the damage type chosen (unless you choose piercing damage).

<title level="2" right="7th">Draconic Frenzy <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

Your eidolon makes one Strike with their primary unarmed attack and two Strikes with their secondary unarmed attack (in any order). If any of these attacks critically hits an enemy, your eidolon instantly recovers the use of their Dragon Breath.

<title level="2" right="17th">Empower Breath <actions string="Free Action" /></title>

**Frequency** once per minute; **Effect** Your eidolon gathers the power of the mightiest archdragons to make their magical breath even more spectacular. If your eidolon's next action is to use Dragon Breath, both the number of damage dice and area of Dragon Breath are doubled.

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 38 Your eidolon is a primal chunk of elemental matter infused with sapience, power, and identity, but unable to manifest a true form of their own without the life force you provide via your connection. Most elementals in their natural environment already have different sorts of forms, from vaguely humanoid, to animalistic, to simple masses of their component element. As your life force provides your eidolon the instincts necessary to adopt a physical form, their appearance varies based on the strength of their own self image and your prior exposure to elementals. Elemental eidolons tend to reach their unusual state— powerful but formless—as the result of large scale events or cataclysms, such as the war to seal the benevolent [Elemental Lords](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8) or their recent unsealing. Whether elemental eidolons possess any memories of a previous life or are a new sapience formed from left-over essence of a mighty servant of the Elemental Lords brought low varies from eidolon to eidolon. Together, you might undertake a journey to understand your eidolon's mysterious past or leave the past behind and forge a new destiny of your own. **Tradition** [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Traits** (Variable)** one more (see Elemental Core, below) **Home Plane** elemental plane matching their Elemental Core --- **Size** Medium **Suggested Attacks** branch (bludgeoning), fist (bludgeoning), spike (piercing), tendril (bludgeoning), wave (bludgeoning) **Adaptable Elemental** - Str 1 - Dex 4 - Con 3 - Int 0 - Wis 1 - Cha 0 - +1 AC (+4 Dex cap) **Primordial Elemental** - Str 4 - Dex 2 - Con 3 - Int -1 - Wis 1 - Cha 0 - +2 AC (+3 Dex cap) **Skills** [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10), [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) **Senses** [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Language** [Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111) (air elemental), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109) (earth elemental), [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110) (fire elemental), [Talican](/Languages.aspx?ID=112) (metal elemental), [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113) (water elemental), or [Muan](/Languages.aspx?ID=108) (wood elemental) **Speed** 25 feet --- **Eidolon Abilities** - **Initial** Elemental Core - **Symbiosis** Elemental Burst - **Transcendence** Elemental Maelstrom Elemental Core Your elemental eidolon is an amalgam of elemental matter and mortal life force, which helps protect them from certain effects that are more harmful to mortals than elementals. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) and [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) effects, as well as effects causing the [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28) condition. Additionally, their elemental essence bleeds less easily than flesh, so the DC of any flat check they make to remove [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) is 10 (or 5 after receiving particularly effective aid). Choose for your eidolon to be an [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508), or [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165) elemental. Your eidolon and all their unarmed attacks gain the trait of the chosen element, and the eidolon gains additional effects based on your choice.
  • **Air**: Your eidolon is formed from elemental air and is light as a breeze. Your eidolon can [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=81), [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36), and [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37) twice as far, and doesn't take falling damage.
  • **Earth**: Your eidolon is formed from elemental earth, and is incredibly hard to move by force. Your eidolon gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38) or [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=40) them. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to knock them [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31). In addition, if any effect would force them to [move](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet or more, they're moved only half the distance.
  • **Fire**: Your eidolon is formed from elemental fire and burns with embers of flame. Your eidolon gains resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to fire and an equal amount of weakness to cold and water. Their unarmed attacks deal 1 additional fire damage.
  • **Metal**: Your eidolon is formed from elemental metal and can adapt their metallic form to battle. One of your eidolon's starting melee unarmed attacks gains the [versatile bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing](/Traits.aspx?ID=200) trait, as your eidolon learns how to shift the metal into various weaponlike forms.
  • **Water**: Your eidolon is formed from elemental water and swims with ease. Your eidolon gains the [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=207) trait, allowing them to breathe in water and air and to avoid the normal –2 penalty for making bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Strikes underwater. Your eidolon's land Speed is reduced to 15 feet, and they gain a swim Speed of 25 feet. You can take the [Amphibious Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=2895) feat to increase their land Speed back up to 25 feet, as described in the feat.
  • **Wood**: Your eidolon is formed from elemental wood, and its living wooden form twists and regrows as you focus your elemental energies. You can choose to have your eidolon gain the [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) trait. Whenever you [Refocus](/Actions.aspx?ID=71), your eidolon regains a number of Hit Points equal to double your level.
Elemental Burst Your eidolon can form projectile attacks from their own body. Your eidolon gains the Elemental Burst activity. Elemental Maelstrom Your eidolon can form a swirling vortex of elemental matter and move across the battlefield, damaging everything in their path. Your eidolon gains the Elemental Maelstrom activity.

Your eidolon gains resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to fire and an equal amount of weakness to cold and water. Their unarmed attacks deal 1 additional fire damage. One of your eidolon's starting melee unarmed attacks gains the versatile bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing trait, as your eidolon learns how to shift the metal into various weaponlike forms. Your eidolon gains the amphibious trait, allowing them to breathe in water and air and to avoid the normal –2 penalty for making bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Strikes underwater. Your eidolon's land Speed is reduced to 15 feet, and they gain a swim Speed of 25 feet. You can take the Amphibious Form feat to increase their land Speed back up to 25 feet, as described in the feat. Your eidolon gains the Elemental Burst activity. Action Elemental Burst Two Actions Source Rage of Elements pg. 39 Frequency once per 10 minutes Your eidolon rips off a chunk of elemental matter from their own form and hurls it into a group of foes. Your eidolon loses a number of Hit Points equal to your level. All creatures in a 20-foot burst within 60 feet take 6d6 damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. **Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 75

Your eidolon is a fey, a capricious being of the mysterious First World. Many fey appear similar to mortal humanoids, with unusual features such as pointed ears, wings, or bodies composed of natural elements, but the full variety of fey is endless, and many others appear completely inhuman. Fey from the First World never truly die, instead eventually forming into a new creature after being destroyed. Fey eidolons usually come about when a summoner helps stabilize a difficult reincarnation. This means your fey eidolon likely lived a different life just before meeting you and might remember fragments of their old memories. Together, you might have to unravel a memory from your eidolon's past life among the fey.

</column>

<title level="2">Fey Gift Spells</title>

Your eidolon expands your primal magic with illusion and mental magic, allowing both of you to wield the power of fey glamour. When you add spells to your repertoire, you can choose from the primal list as well as from spells that have the [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629) or [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) traits that appear on the [arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1) spell list. As usual for when you add spells of a different tradition to your spell list, you're still a primal spellcaster, so all your spells are primal spells. Your eidolon gains the [Magical Understudy](/Feats.aspx?ID=9231) summoner feat, despite not meeting the prerequisite level, and can choose fey gift cantrips in addition to primal cantrips. As normal for a feat you are granted by name, you can't retrain Magical Understudy into another feat.

<title level="2" right="7th">Fey Mischief</title>

Your eidolon's fey magic becomes more powerful and mischievous. Your eidolon gains the [Magical Adept](/Feats.aspx?ID=9255) feat, despite not meeting the prerequisite level, and can choose from fey gift spells in addition to primal spells.

<title level="2" right="17th">Fey Chicanery</title>

Ever full of tricks, your fey eidolon twists magical protections into your shared life force, granting them a [_contingency_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1472) in their back pocket for desperate situations. During your daily preparations, your eidolon can cast a _contingency_ spell. The 4th-rank spell they choose must come from the primal or fey gift list, and must either be common or be another spell you have access to.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 76

Your eidolon is a simple creature of protoplasm held together by magic and your mind. They often appear as creeping blobs of a single color, but this doesn't mean they can't have distinctive features, such as moss or fungus growing on their surface or bones and other debris floating within. Because they have been formed by your thoughts, your ooze eidolon isn't mindless, but likely doesn't have a complete personality. Though your ooze eidolon speaks no language, you might believe you can interpret the constant burbles and plops they make as a form of speaking.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title level="2">Ooze Physiology</title>

You and your ooze eidolon are directly connected in both body and mind, which renders your eidolon susceptible to effects that wouldn't normally bother an ooze. They don't have an ooze's normal immunities, but do gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1 resistance) against acid, critical hits, and precision damage and a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects. Additionally, their surface closes quickly after being wounded. The flat check to remove [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) from the eidolon is DC 10 (or DC 5 after receiving particularly effective aid).

<title level="2" right="7th">Stretching Pseudopods</title>

Your eidolon's pseudopods can stretch farther. All your eidolon's melee unarmed attacks gain the [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=684) trait.

<title level="2" right="17th">Flowing Engulf <actions string="Three Actions" /></title>

Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of any creatures in their path. Any creature of the eidolon's size or smaller whose space your eidolon moves through is engulfed unless it succeeds at a Reflex save against your spell DC. Your eidolon can attempt to engulf the same creature only once in a single use of Flowing Engulf, and they can contain as many creatures as can fit in their space.

 An engulfed creature is pulled into your eidolon's body. It is grabbed, [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1, and moves along with your eidolon as long as it is engulfed. It can get free by [Escaping](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) against your spell DC, moving to a space of its choice adjacent to your eidolon.

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 66

Your eidolon is a [psychopomp](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=83), a creature whose sworn duty is to usher souls safely to the afterlife and maintain the courts of the dead. Psychopomp eidolons have a variety of appearances, but since they often traffic with mortals, their form typically includes an elaborate mask. You and your psychopomp eidolon share an important fate together, whether it relates directly to your own soul or to a mission that will somehow protect the souls of others.

<column gap="tiny">

**Tradition** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2)

**Alignment** must be true neutral

**Home Plane** [The Boneyard](/Planes.aspx?ID=15)

</column>

---

**Size** Medium

**Suggested Attacks** beak (piercing), claw (slashing), fist (bludgeoning), jaws (piercing), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

- Wis 12
- Cha 8
- +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

**Scribe of the Dead**
- Str 12

**Eidolon Abilities**

- **Initial** Spirit Touch
- **Symbiosis** Hidden Watcher
- **Transcendence** Spirit Taker

</column>

<title level="2">Spirit Touch</title>

Your eidolon's attacks possess a psychopomp's ability to harm the living and the dead. Your eidolon's unarmed Strikes affect [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=222) creatures as though etched with a [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297) property rune and deal an extra 1 negative damage to living creatures and an extra 1 positive damage to [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160).

<title level="2" right="7th">Hidden Watcher</title>

Your eidolon can render both of you unseen. Once per hour, it can cast [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) targeting you, them, or both of you at once. If the spell targeted both of you, the spell ends for both of you if either of you uses a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300).

<title level="2" right="17th">Spirit Taker</title>

Your eidolon is particularly capable when it comes to handling bodiless spirits and putting [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) to their final rest. Your eidolon can see [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=222) creatures inside of solid objects and can attack them with Strikes without penalty; an incorporeal creature in a solid object that takes damage from your eidolon's Strike is expelled from the object to the nearest available space, moving closer to your eidolon if possible.

 Additionally, your eidolon can target or affect a creature projecting its consciousness (such as via [_project image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=237)) or possessing another creature, even if its body is elsewhere, though your eidolon must know about the possession or projection and choose to do so.

 Finally, the spirit of an undead destroyed by your eidolon's Strikes is sent directly to the [Boneyard](/Planes.aspx?ID=15) for judgment; an undead with an ability to avoid such a fate automatically, such as a [ghost's](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=51) rejuvenation, can attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against your spell DC to return via that ability as normal. In that case, it uses its Will save modifier as its counteract modifier.

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 72

Your eidolon is a collective of primal energy and nature spirits, gathered into a single fragmentary being. This collection of natural energy has neither form nor identity until bonded with a summoner. You give these spirits purpose, connecting with them and drawing them through to the physical realm. When manifesting, these nature spirits don a simple form, adopting the guise of many Tiny animals. Each of these animals is the same creature and is marked with your summoner’s sigil. The act of manifesting in this swarm form temporarily binds the spirits together into one being, making the eidolon a single entity—one mind and personality speaking with a multitude of voices, and a multitude of bodies acting in concert with a singular purpose.

</column>

<title level="2">Swarm Form</title>

Your eidolon is an intelligent swarm composed of hundreds of Tiny creatures, and it’s immune to the grabbed, prone, and restrained conditions. It can fit through tight spaces as though it were a Tiny creature. It has weakness to area damage equal to its level. Your eidolon has two forms: condensed and dispersed. When you Manifest Eidolon, it manifests condensed. It can switch between these two forms as a single action that has the concentrate trait. 

**Condensed Form:** When condensed, your eidolon draws all its component bodies into a single, condensed mound that functions as a Medium creature. It has a reach of 5 feet, can make Strikes, and can’t occupy the same space as other creatures. While condensed, it can use the Haunting Visage action.

**Dispersed Form:** When dispersed, your eidolon scatters its component bodies across a wider area, increasing its size by one category (to Large for most swarm eidolons). It has a reach of 0 feet, can’t make Strikes, and can occupy the same space as other creatures. While dispersed, it can use the Swarming Assault activity.

<document level="2" id="action-3307" />

<title level="2" right="7th">Sudden Shift</title>

Once per round, your eidolon can switch forms between condensed and dispersed as a free action, rather than a single action. In addition, your eidolon gains the Redistribute reaction.

<document level="3" id="action-3308"/>

<title level="2" right="17th">Sickening Swarm</title>

Your eidolon is particularly good at distracting and hindering its foes while dispersed. While dispersed, spaces your eidolon occupies are difficult terrain for other creatures. In addition, your eidolon gains the Sickening Assault action.

<title level="1" right="Summoner Eidolon " pfs="Standard">[Undead](/Eidolons.aspx?ID=11)</title>

<traits>

</traits>

**Source** [Book of the Dead](/Sources.aspx?ID=118) pg. 36

Your eidolon is an undead spirit pulled from the [Ethereal Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=9) or [Negative Energy Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=2), embodied, and bound to your life force in an unusual, potentially antithetical way that even other summoners can't quite understand. Undead eidolons take about every imaginable shape and form, as their bodies manifest from their connection to you. Their ultimate form can be influenced by an amalgamation of the echoes and memories of their old life before becoming undead, their cause of death, their encounters in the afterlife, and portions of your own essences. Together, you and your eidolon need to explore the mysteries of life, death, and undeath to understand what your bond means for both of your futures.

<column gap="tiny">

**Tradition** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2)

**Home Plane** [Ethereal Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=9) or [Negative Energy Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=2)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Size** Medium or Small

**Suggested Attacks** claw (slashing), fist (bludgeoning), jaws (piercing)

**Undead Brute**
- Str 18
- Dex 14
- Con 16
- Int 8
- Wis 10
- Cha 12
- +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

**Undead Stalker**
- Str 14
- Dex 18
- Con 16
- Int 8
- Wis 12
- Cha 10
- +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

**Skills** [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7), [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13)

**Senses** [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Language** [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20)

**Speed** 25 feet

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Eidolon Abilities**

- **Initial** Negative Essence
- **Symbiosis** Drain Life
- **Transcendence** Rejuvenation

</column>

<title level="2">Negative Essence</title>

Your undead eidolon has a link directly to your life force, which grants it a twilight state between living and undead. This renders it a living creature and therefore susceptible to many ailments that bother only the living, though it does possess some resistances to these effects. 

The eidolon has [negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42), meaning it heals from negative energy effects that heal undead and is damaged by positive energy effects that damage undead. It doesn't have an undead's normal immunities, but it does gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), and [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) effects, and non-damaging effects that target only undead. Additionally, its necrotic essence stanches its wounds easily. The flat check to remove [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) from the eidolon is DC 10 (or DC 5 after receiving particularly effective aid).

<title level="2" right="7th">Drain Life</title>

Your eidolon's link with you sustains it, but it still craves the life essence of the living, whether through blood or pure essence. It gains the Drain Life activity.

<document level="3" id="action-1168"/>

<title level="2" right="17th">Rejuvenation</title>

Your eidolon's unusual connection with you allows you both to rejuvenate when defeated. The first time each day your turn begins while you're [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11), you instantly regain a number of Hit Points equal to three times your level and wake up. (Increase your [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=42) condition as normal.) You can immediately [Manifest your Eidolon](/Actions.aspx?ID=757) as a free action. You can then take your turn as normal.
